skill.summary: A/B evaluates any AI agent skill's real impact through three-role isolation (orchestrator + two sub-agents). Generates skill profiles, synthetic test tasks,...

latestVersion.changelog: v1.0.0: Three-role isolation architecture. Orchestrator designs tasks and scores; two isolated sub-agents execute baseline and with-skill arms. Progressive disclosure (DISPATCH_PROTOCOL.md + SCORING_REFERENCE.md). dispatch_evidence guardrail. Self-execution detection.
